beats.say: Minecraft is the best selling video game of all time, with a history stretching back over a decade.
It first appeared as an early access title on 17 May 2009 before its official release on 18 November 2011 for personal computers.
The entire digital world is constructed from rough three dimensional objects known as blocks, represented as voxels on screen.
Over 400 million copies have been sold around the globe, making it a massive cultural phenomenon.
Along the way, the creative community stepped in to offer user generated texture packs that completely transform the visual style.
What is your favourite texture pack to use when you play the game?

facts: Minecraft is the best selling video game of all time.

Minecraft was first released as an early access title on 17 May 2009.
Minecraft was formally released on 18 November 2011 for personal computers.
The game worlds are composed of rough 3D objects called blocks.
The Minecraft community offers user generated texture packs.
